instructions: Should this message be offered a fresh thread? Check three conditions: it asks for substantive work, it is a separate task rather than the next step of the current task, and it can be understood without prior thread-specific entities, constraints, results, or decisions. Answer yes only when all three hold. Greetings, acknowledgements, pause/resume messages, status requests and ambiguous references are no. The fresh thread keeps the same project, environment, tools and standing project instructions.

criteria.true: A self-contained actionable new task warrants a fresh thread.
criteria.false: Earlier context matters, no new task is requested, or the distinction is unclear.
